\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 253-256 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R261-first-pass-words-from-chapters-253-256}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to lie down and to move house.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to get off, to enter, to go out, to push, to throw
  \item to take off, to prepare, to iron, to fold, to hang up
  \item to shout, to brush one's teeth, to weigh, to bite, to chew
  \item to download, to use, to try, to travel, to retire
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To get off? (\textbf{\fa{پیاده} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{piyâde shodan}.) To enter? (\textbf{\fa{وارد} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{vâred shodan}.) To go out? (\textbf{\fa{خارج} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{khârej shodan}.) To push? (\textbf{\fa{هل} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{hel dâdan}.) To throw? (\textbf{\fa{انداختن}}, \emph{andâkhtan}.) To take off? (\textbf{\fa{درآوردن}}, \emph{darâvardan}.) To prepare? (\textbf{\fa{آماده} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{âmâde kardan}.) To iron? (\textbf{\fa{اتو} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{otu kardan}.) To fold? (\textbf{\fa{تا} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tâ kardan}.) To hang up? (\textbf{\fa{آویزان} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{âvizân kardan}.) To shout? (\textbf{\fa{داد} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{dâd zadan}.) To brush one's teeth? (\textbf{\fa{مسواک} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{mesvâk zadan}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\fa{وزن} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{vazn kardan}.) To bite? (\textbf{\fa{گاز} \fa{گرفتن}}, \emph{gâz gereftan}.) To chew? (\textbf{\fa{جویدن}}, \emph{javidan}.) To download? (\textbf{\fa{دانلود} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{dânlod kardan}.) To use? (\textbf{\fa{استفاده} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{estefâde kardan}.) To try? (\textbf{\fa{تلاش} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{talâsh kardan}.) To travel? (\textbf{\fa{مسافرت} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{mosâferat kardan}.) To retire? (\textbf{\fa{بازنشسته} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{bâzneshaste shodan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 257-261 — a second pass}

  \item to search, to phone, to fix, to agree, to imagine
  \item to check, to haggle, to steal, to escape, to sweep
  \item to grate, to make a hole in, to tie a knot, to knock at the door, to whistle
  \item to dress, to be admitted to hospital, to lean, to lie down, to move house

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To miss? (\textbf{\fa{دلتنگ} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{deltang shodan}.) To grow up? (\textbf{\fa{بزرگ} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{bozorg shodan}.) To feel? (\textbf{\fa{احساس} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{ehsâs kardan}.) To promise? (\textbf{\fa{قول} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{qol dâdan}.) To complain? (\textbf{\fa{شکایت} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{shekâyat kardan}.) To search? (\textbf{\fa{جستجو} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{jostoju kardan}.) To phone? (\textbf{\fa{زنگ} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{zang zadan}.) To fix? (\textbf{\fa{درست} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{dorost kardan}.) To agree? (\textbf{\fa{موافق} \fa{بودن}}, \emph{movâfeq budan}.) To imagine? (\textbf{\fa{تصور} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tasavvor kardan}.) To check? (\textbf{\fa{بررسی} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{barrasi kardan}.) To haggle? (\textbf{\fa{چانه} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{châne zadan}.) To steal? (\textbf{\fa{دزدیدن}}, \emph{dozdidan}.) To escape? (\textbf{\fa{فرار} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{farâr kardan}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\fa{جارو} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{jâru kardan}.) To grate? (\textbf{\fa{رنده} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{rande kardan}.) To make a hole in? (\textbf{\fa{سوراخ} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{surâkh kardan}.) To tie a knot? (\textbf{\fa{گره} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{gereh zadan}.) To knock at the door? (\textbf{\fa{در} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{dar zadan}.) To whistle? (\textbf{\fa{سوت} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{sut zadan}.) To dress? (\textbf{\fa{پانسمان} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{pânsemân kardan}.) To be admitted to hospital? (\textbf{\fa{بستری} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{bastari shodan}.) To lean? (\textbf{\fa{تکیه} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{tekye dâdan}.) To lie down? (\textbf{\fa{دراز} \fa{کشیدن}}, \emph{derâz keshidan}.) To move house? (\textbf{\fa{اسباب} \fa{کشی} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{asbâbkeshi kardan}.)
